cards.subtitle: Drawing the village's people as a force-directed graph.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · GRAPH READS THE /graph PAYLOAD AS-IS

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Payload in: nodes, scored edges, weight vector. D3 takes it raw.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Each node styled by profile: colour is domain, ring is stage.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Colour by domain sells the wrong story — topic clumps look right.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Edge thickness now tracks match score, not domain overlap.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Hover shows my one-line rationale straight off the edge.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Sixty synthetic nodes render smooth. Layout settles fast.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: First render is honest to the scores. Shipped.

cards.subtitle: Click a node, see why the village thinks what it thinks.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · PANEL SHOWS THE WHY, NOT JUST THE WHO

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Node click opens the panel: profile summary, path, the ask.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Below that, top matches with my scores in order.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Scores without reasons are just numbers. Show the rationale.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Each match row expands into my full reasoning for the pair.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: And flag which weight drove it — trajectory or seeking-fit.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Panel reads clean at demo distance. Done.

cards.subtitle: Showing the graph reshape when new weights arrive.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · THE REWEIGHT IS THE MONEY SHOT

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: New weight vector lands — the graph must visibly reorganise.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Re-scoring every edge, then letting the forces re-settle.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: A hard snap loses the story. Nobody sees what moved.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Tweening edge weights over two seconds — clumps dissolve on screen.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Caption during the move: shared trajectory beats shared topic.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Ran it with generation-five weights. Topic clumps melt into arcs.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: That animation is the demo's proof. Locked.
